value.answer: A runny nose and mild cough with no fever, in a child who is eating and playing normally, is often just a common cold. Colds usually last 3 to 7 days, and a cough can linger a couple of weeks. Fluids, rest and saline nose drops help.
value.triage: Call 811 if it isn't better after 10 days, or for ear pain, pus in the eyes, fever, or poor drinking. Go to the ER or call 911 now for fast or hard breathing, ribs pulling in, blue lips, or if your child is very sleepy or hard to wake.
